items.title: How AI Is Changing is Changing Journalism and News Media
items.summary: “AI is transforming the way we engage with news and media, particularly in relation to access, reliability and trust,” Naomi Goulder, deputy dean and associate dean of Innovation and Enterprise innovation and enterprise at Northeastern University London, said in an interview with Northeastern Global News. [...] Microsoft and Barclays are among some of the latest companies that have announced thousands of job cuts linked to their implementation of AI. British publishers Reach and Future announced hundreds of layoffs in recent months as some readers rely on AI summaries instead of clicking on complete articles. Journalists have emphasized the value of humans gathering and confirming the accuracy of information as opposed to the AI collection of often unconfirmed commentary available on the internet. [...] At the same time, AI has had a revolutionary impact on multiple aspects of human life. In the past five years, chatbots like Claude and ChatGPT have transformed how people access information. Employers are using AI to complete tasks. Companies such as BenevolentAI in London are using AI to predict which chemical compounds will be able to cure diseases.

items.title: Adobe Max 2026 Live Updates: All the AI, Photo and Video News - CNET
items.summary: The biggest changes are the general release of AI assistants in Photoshop, Adobe Express and its AI hub, Firefly, first teased at last year’s conference. These assistants are similar to chatbots, where you enter your request and the AI does the editing for you. Adobe also released AI music generation tools and new photo editing modes. For video editors, too, there are the new Premiere mobile apps. [...] Adobe’s flagship programs, like Photoshop, have undergone major AI makeovers, including recent developments like AI audio and soundtrack generation. This has been to the dismay of some of its creative customers who are wary of generative AI. This year is expected to be no different. But there are other tensions brewing, including Adobe’s $75 million settlement with the US Justice Department over subscription cancellations and new vibe-coded and free Adobe alternatives. [...] Adobe tech is also now showing up in ChatGPT and Claude; Disney is using Firefly to help design theme park rides. And from what CNET has heard from Adobe execs, the company isn’t planning to slow down its AI research any time soon.

# Tin nóng công nghệ 9/11: iPhone Air 2 có thể được bổ sung camera thứ 2

13:36 09/11/2026

iPhone Air 2 có thể có camera thứ 2, Samsung hé lộ smartphone màn hình trượt, trong khi chuyên gia Tencent cảnh báo nguy cơ AI bị lợi dụng để phát triển vũ khí sinh học là những tin công nghệ đáng chú ý ngày 9/11.

Mục lục

Minh Qun

1. iPhone Air 2 có thể được bổ sung camera thứ 2 [...] Vivo đang phát triển mẫu điện thoại gập mới có màn hình nhỏ hơn 6,5 inch nhằm cạnh tranh với iPhone Duo và Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. Theo PhoneArena, thông tin bắt nguồn từ tài khoản Digital Chat Station trên mạng xã hội Weibo.

Vivo có thể ra mắt điện thoại gập nhỏ gọn để cạnh tranh với iPhone Duo. Ảnh: PhoneArena. [...] Theo Bloomberg, Apple đang thử nghiệm iPhone Air 2 với camera góc siêu rộng bên cạnh camera chính 48 MP. Camera mới có thể giúp người dùng chụp phong cảnh và nhóm đông người linh hoạt hơn. Hãng cũng đang tìm cách cải thiện thời lượng pin nhưng chưa rõ phương án cụ thể.

iPhone Air hiện còn một số hạn chế như chỉ có một loa, cổng USB 2 và tốc độ sạc thấp hơn dòng Pro. Theo 9to5Mac, những điểm yếu này có thể khiến người dùng cn nhắc khi giá bán gần bằng iPhone Pro.

微軟一份公開專利描述：PC、筆電與手機閒置時，GPU 可接收切分後的微型 AI 訓練任務；是否產品化、如何補償，仍未定案。

美國專利局於 11 月 5 日公開的 US-20260349820-A1，描述一套邊緣運算系統：先辨識裝置的 GPU、記憶體與網路頻寬等資源，再把大型訓練工作拆成可獨立執行的小任務，依設備條件分派工作。設計目標是避免任務超出裝置負荷。

專利也提到依貢獻提供獎勵，可能包括 Xbox 點數、AI 使用額度或訂閱服務折抵；但這些都還是專利文件中的構想，並不代表微軟已公布實際服務、參與條件或回饋標準。

把閒置裝置算力集中使用並非新概念。HTC 曾推動 Power To Give，讓充電中的手機協助醫療與研究開發；另一方面，集體挖礦與惡意程式也讓使用者更在意裝置資源被誰使用、耗電如何計算與是否能隨時退出。

AI 訓練的難點在於資料量龐大，且不少訓練流程需要持續運作，未必容易切成小工作。因此，目前算力通常仍由專業機構以機房設備提供。這份專利的意義，在於嘗試把分散式裝置納入訓練流程；若真的落地，技術之外，透明同意、資源限制與獎勵是否足以覆蓋電力和硬體成本，將是關鍵。

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

See Also: Frictionless Security: How AI is Redefining Access in Highly Regulated Industries [...] For enterprise technology leaders, the announcements are a mixed bag. OpenAI is attempting to ensure it has access to the compute it will need to grow by assuaging the concerns of communities that are increasingly saying no to data center expansion, but for businesses that are still trying to formulate their AI strategy, OpenAI's compact doesn't offer much certainty. [...] The compact outlined locally tailored agreements for future OpenAI campuses, community input into development plans and annual public progress reports. OpenAI said it will cover the electricity it consumes and the incremental infrastructure costs required to serve its sites.
